{
  "scope": {
    "business_name_en": "DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) — operated by The Depository Trust Company (DTC)",
    "business_name_zh": "DTCC代币化服务（DTS）——由存托信托公司（DTC）运营",
    "included": [
      "Tokenization and de-tokenization (conversion) of eligible DTC-custodied securities",
      "Delivery of tokenized securities to DTC Participant wallets on supported blockchain networks",
      "Network selection and evaluation framework for blockchain integration",
      "Participant onboarding and eligibility controls",
      "Conversion order windows and 24/7 token transfer capability",
      "Limited-production milestone trades (July 15, 2026)",
      "Broad service launch (October 28, 2026)"
    ],
    "excluded": [
      "DDA (DTCC Digital Assets) technology products — distinct from DTS",
      "NSCC and FICC clearing and settlement operations",
      "Non-DTC-custodied or ineligible asset classes",
      "Blockchain networks not yet approved under the evaluation framework",
      "Retail investor access (service is limited to eligible DTC Participants)",
      "Non-U.S. regulatory regimes and cross-border tokenization rules",
      "Internal financial buffers, margin ratios, and CCP risk models",
      "Historic DAS operating data (no pre-launch operational history exists)"
    ],
    "date_limitations": [
      "SEC No-Action Letter issued December 2025; three-year authorization period from that date",
      "Limited-production trades occurred July 15, 2026 only",
      "Broad service launch date: October 28, 2026",
      "Network framework last updated August 12, 2026",
      "No operational performance data exists prior to October 28, 2026; all pre-launch figures are pre-commercial",
      "Additional blockchain networks stated as planned for 2027 — not yet live"
    ]
  },
  "facts": [
    {
      "fact_id": "F01",
      "source_id": "launch",
      "category": "Service Launch",
      "statement_en": "DTS launched on October 28, 2026 as a live service enabling tokenization of DTC-custodied securities.",
      "statement_zh": "DTS于2026年10月28日正式上线，支持对DTC托管证券进行代币化。",
      "evidence_quote": "today launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS)",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "Launch date confirmed; no operational volume or throughput data published."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F02",
      "source_id": "hub",
      "category": "Regulatory Authorization",
      "statement_en": "DTS is authorized under an SEC No-Action Letter issued in December 2025 for a three-year period; this is staff-level relief, not blanket Commission approval.",
      "statement_zh": "DTS依据2025年12月发布的SEC不采取行动函获得授权，有效期三年；该函件为SEC工作人员立场，非委员会全面批准。",
      "evidence_quote": "authorized under an SEC No-Action Letter issued in December 2025 ... three-year authorization period",
      "date": "2025-12-01",
      "measured_metric": "Authorization duration",
      "measured_value": 3,
      "unit": "years",
      "limitation": "No-Action Letter is SEC staff position only; does not constitute Commission rulemaking or blanket approval."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F03",
      "source_id": "launch",
      "category": "Eligible Assets",
      "statement_en": "Eligible assets include Russell 1000 constituents, ETFs tracking major indices, and U.S. Treasury securities, per the SEC No-Action Letter.",
      "statement_zh": "根据SEC不采取行动函，合格资产包括罗素1000成分股、追踪主要指数的ETF及美国国债。",
      "evidence_quote": "DTC received a No-Action Letter from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission authorizing it to tokenize Russell 1000 constituents, exchange-traded funds tracking major indices, and U.S. Treasury securities",
      "date": "2025-12-01",
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "Asset eligibility is defined and constrained by the No-Action Letter; other asset classes are excluded unless separately authorized."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F04",
      "source_id": "launch",
      "category": "Participant Onboarding",
      "statement_en": "As of launch, 20 DTC Participants had signed agreements to access DTS; future users to be onboarded on a rolling basis.",
      "statement_zh": "截至上线日，已有20家DTC参与者签署协议接入DTS；未来用户将滚动式陆续接入。",
      "evidence_quote": "20 DTC Participants (clients) have signed agreements to access DTS",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": "Signed participant agreements",
      "measured_value": 20,
      "unit": "DTC Participants",
      "limitation": "Signed agreements indicate onboarding intent, not confirmed active transacting users."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F05",
      "source_id": "notice_das001",
      "category": "Conversion Window / Operating Hours",
      "statement_en": "Conversion orders (tokenization/de-tokenization) may be submitted Monday–Friday 2:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. ET; token transfers on supported networks are available 24/7.",
      "statement_zh": "代币化/去代币化转换指令可在周一至周五美东时间凌晨2:00至下午6:00提交；支持网络上的代币转账全天候（24/7）可用。",
      "evidence_quote": "conversion orders may be submitted to DTC Monday through Friday between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. ET",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "Operating window applies to conversion orders only; on-chain token transfers are not subject to this window."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F06",
      "source_id": "notice_das001",
      "category": "Wallet / Network Controls",
      "statement_en": "Post-tokenization transfers are restricted to 'allowed listed wallets on supported networks', indicating a whitelist control.",
      "statement_zh": "代币化后的转账仅限于"支持网络上的已允许白名单钱包"，表明存在白名单控制机制。",
      "evidence_quote": "transfers of that token may occur 24 hours a day, seven days a week between allowed listed wallets on supported networks",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "Whitelist criteria, wallet vetting process, and maximum wallet count are not publicly disclosed."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F07",
      "source_id": "launch",
      "category": "Supported Networks",
      "statement_en": "At launch, DTS is integrated with Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network; additional networks are planned for 2027.",
      "statement_zh": "上线时，DTS已与Canton网络及DTCC私有Besu网络集成；计划于2027年新增其他区块链网络。",
      "evidence_quote": "The service is currently integrated with the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network, with additional blockchain networks to be added in 2027",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": "Supported blockchain networks at launch",
      "measured_value": 2,
      "unit": "networks",
      "limitation": "Future network additions are stated intentions only; subject to evaluation framework and regulatory review."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F08",
      "source_id": "limited_production",
      "category": "Limited Production Milestone",
      "statement_en": "On July 15, 2026, more than 30 firms completed limited-production trades across multiple asset classes and use cases on Besu and Canton networks.",
      "statement_zh": "2026年7月15日，逾30家机构在Besu和Canton网络上完成了涵盖多种资产类别和用例的有限生产交易。",
      "evidence_quote": "More than 30 firms representing a cross-section of traditional financial institutions (TradFi) and digital market participants took part in the initiative",
      "date": "2026-07-15",
      "measured_metric": "Participating firms in limited-production event",
      "measured_value": 30,
      "unit": "firms (minimum)",
      "limitation": "This was a single-day limited-production event, not sustained operational history; transaction volumes not disclosed."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F09",
      "source_id": "limited_production",
      "category": "Use Cases Validated",
      "statement_en": "Limited-production trades included collateral pledge, securities lending, U.S. Treasury/repo DVP, equity DVP, equity DVD, equity token transfer, and CCP margin workflows.",
      "statement_zh": "有限生产交易涵盖质押担保、证券借贷、美国国债/回购DVP、股票DVP、股票DVD、股票代币转账及中央对手方保证金工作流。",
      "evidence_quote": "collateral pledge, security lending, U.S. Treasury/repo delivery-versus-payment (DVP) trade, equity DVP trade, equity delivery-versus-delivery (DVD) trade, equity token transfer and central counterparty (CCP) margin workflows",
      "date": "2026-07-15",
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "Use cases were demonstrated in a single controlled event; sustained operational performance across these workflows is unconfirmed."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F10",
      "source_id": "launch",
      "category": "Investor Protections / No Collateral Value Restriction",
      "statement_en": "Tokenized securities retain the ownership rights, investor protections and economic entitlements of their traditional counterparts; no statement is made that tokenized securities carry independent collateral value beyond the underlying DTC-held asset.",
      "statement_zh": "代币化证券保留与传统证券相同的所有权权利、投资者保护及经济权益；文件未声明代币化证券具有独立于DTC托管底层资产之外的担保价值。",
      "evidence_quote": "Tokenized securities, or digital twins, retain the ownership rights, investor protections and economic entitlements of their traditional counterparts",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "No public document specifies collateral valuation methodology for tokenized form; collateral value derives from underlying DTC-held security."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F11",
      "source_id": "network_framework",
      "category": "Network Governance / Exclusion Controls",
      "statement_en": "DTCC's network evaluation framework applies non-discretionary exclusion criteria including regulatory concerns, inadequate governance transparency, audit-resistant privacy features, and unresolved critical security concerns.",
      "statement_zh": "DTCC网络评估框架设有非自由裁量排除标准，包括监管合规问题、治理透明度不足、抗审计隐私功能及未解决的重大安全隐患。",
      "evidence_quote": "These criteria are non-discretionary in nature and reflect minimum requirements for participation in a regulated environment",
      "date": null,
      "measured_metric": null,
      "measured_value": null,
      "unit": null,
      "limitation": "Framework describes criteria; actual network evaluation outcomes and rejected candidates are not publicly disclosed."
    },
    {
      "fact_id": "F12",
      "source_id": "launch",
      "category": "Industry Collaboration / Working Group",
      "statement_en": "DTS was developed with input from more than 150 firms in the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group.",
      "statement_zh": "DTS在DTC数字资产解决方案行业工作组逾150家机构的参与下开发完成。",
      "evidence_quote": "Developed with input from more than 150 firms in the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group",
      "date": "2026-10-28",
      "measured_metric": "Working group member firms",
      "measured_value": 150,
      "unit": "firms (minimum)",
      "limitation": "Working group participation reflects design input, not confirmed DTS users or transaction counterparties."
    }
  ],
  "chains": [
    {
      "card_id": "DAS-01",
      "name_en": "Blockchain Network Outage / Finality Failure",
      "name_zh": "区块链网络中断／最终性失败风险",
      "external_shock": "Technical failure, consensus disruption, or sequencer outage on Canton Network or DTCC Besu network",
      "transmission_pathway_en": "Network outage or loss of transaction finality on a supported chain → tokenized securities cannot be transferred or settled on-chain → participants holding tokenized form cannot meet delivery or collateral obligations → forced de-tokenization demand spikes during conversion window → conversion window capacity (Mon–Fri 2am–6pm ET) becomes a bottleneck → settlement fails or delays cascade into traditional markets",
      "transmission_pathway_zh": "支持链发生网络中断或交易最终性丧失→链上代币化证券无法转账或结算→持有代币化形式的参与者无法履行交割或担保义务→去代币化需求在转换窗口期激增→转换窗口容量（周一至周五美东时间凌晨2:00至下午6:00）成为瓶颈→结算失败或延迟向传统市场蔓延",
      "mechanism_source_ids": ["notice_das001", "launch", "network_framework"],
      "mechanism_evidence_quote": "conversion orders may be submitted to DTC Monday through Friday between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. ET",
      "mechanism_evidence_source_id": "notice_das001",
      "proposed_internal_buffer_metric": "Maximum daily conversion order capacity (tokenization + de-tokenization) within the operating window",
      "metric_units": "Conversion orders per day",
      "risk_direction": "Upward — network failure increases conversion demand against a fixed daily window",
      "real_v_available": false,
      "exact_data_needed": "Daily conversion order volumes, peak queue depth, processing throughput per hour within the window, historical network uptime for Canton and Besu",
      "public_external_information_to_collect": "Canton Network and Besu public incident logs; blockchain explorer finality metrics; DTCC Important Notices for any DTS service interruptions",
      "simulation_suitable": true,
      "simulation_limits": "No observed DTS operational data; simulation must use hypothetical conversion volumes and assumed network failure rates; results are entirely counterfactual",
      "public_driver_candidate": "Canton Network public status page; LFDT Besu GitHub incident history",
      "validation_needed": "Obtain DTC internal conversion order throughput capacity; confirm whether a queue overflow or rejection protocol exists; validate network SLA commitments"
    },
    {
      "card_id": "DAS-02",
      "name_en": "Asset Eligibility Boundary Breach / Regulatory Scope Creep",
      "name_zh": "资产合格性边界突破／监管范围蔓延风险",
      "external_shock": "Participant attempts to tokenize an ineligible security, or SEC modifies or withdraws the No-Action Letter before the three-year term expires",
      "transmission_pathway_en": "Participant submits conversion order for asset outside authorized scope (non-Russell-1000, non-major-index ETF, non-UST) OR SEC rescinds or amends No-Action Letter → DTC must reject orders or suspend service → participants with tokenized positions face forced de-tokenization → liquidity in tokenized form evaporates → collateral arrangements relying on tokenized securities must be unwound → potential regulatory enforcement action against DTC as SIFMU",
      "transmission_pathway_zh": "参与者提交超出授权范围资产（非罗素1000、非主要指数ETF、非美国国债）的转换指令，或SEC撤销/修订不采取行动函→DTC须拒绝指令或暂停服务→持有代币化头寸的参与者面临强制去代币化→代币化形式流动性骤降→依赖代币化证券的担保安排须解除→DTC作为系统重要性金融市场基础设施面临潜在监管执法风险",
      "mechanism_source_ids": ["launch", "hub", "network_framework"],
      "mechanism_evidence_quote": "authorized under an SEC No-Action Letter issued in December 2025 ... three-year authorization period",
      "mechanism_evidence_source_id": "hub",
      "proposed_internal_buffer_metric": "Proportion of tokenized assets confirmed within authorized eligibility categories at any point in time",
      "metric_units": "Percentage of tokenized positions in eligible asset classes",
      "risk_direction": "Upward — any expansion of tokenized asset universe beyond authorized scope increases regulatory exposure",
      "real_v_available": false,
      "exact_data_needed": "DTC's internal eligibility screening logic and rejection rate for conversion orders; breakdown of tokenized positions by asset class; No-Action Letter full text and conditions",
      "public_external_information_to_collect": "SEC No-Action Letter (December 2025, not yet publicly linked in supplied documents); SEC staff statements on tokenization; any SEC rulemaking on digital asset securities",
      "simulation_suitable": false,
      "simulation_limits": "Regulatory withdrawal is a binary event; probability cannot be modeled without access to SEC correspondence and DTC compliance monitoring data",
      "public_driver_candidate": "SEC EDGAR for No-Action Letter filings; SEC press releases on digital asset policy",
      "validation_needed": "Obtain full No-Action Letter text; confirm DTC's eligibility screening controls and escalation procedures; assess whether existing DTC rules require amendment for DTS"
    },
    {
      "card_id": "DAS-03",
      "name_en": "Wallet Compromise / Unauthorized Token Transfer",
      "name_zh": "钱包被攻击／未授权代币转账风险",
      "external_shock": "Cyberattack, private key compromise, or insider threat targeting a participant's whitelisted wallet",
      "transmission_pathway_en": "Whitelisted wallet private key is compromised → attacker initiates unauthorized on-chain token transfer to non-whitelisted address → tokens leave the controlled ecosystem → DTC cannot reverse on-chain transfer unilaterally → underlying DTC-held security remains at DTC but token ownership record diverges from DTC books → reconciliation failure between on-chain token ledger and DTC official records → participant suffers loss; DTC faces record integrity challenge",
      "transmission_pathway_zh": "白名单钱包私钥遭泄露→攻击者发起未授权链上代币转账至非白名单地址→代币脱离受控生态系统→DTC无法单方面撤销链上转账→DTC托管的底层证券仍在DTC，但代币所有权记录与DTC账簿产生分歧→链上代币账本与DTC官方记录对账失败→参与者遭受损失；DTC面临记录完整性挑战",
      "mechanism_source_ids": ["notice_das001", "network_framework", "launch"],
      "mechanism_evidence_quote": "transfers of that token may occur 24 hours a day, seven days a week between allowed listed wallets on supported networks",
      "mechanism_evidence_source_id": "notice_das001",
      "proposed_internal_buffer_metric": "Number of active whitelisted wallets; wallet vetting and re-validation cycle frequency",
      "metric_units": "Whitelisted wallets (count); re-validation interval (days)",
      "risk_direction": "Upward — 24/7 transfer capability increases the attack surface relative to traditional settlement windows",
      "real_v_available": false,
      "exact_data_needed": "Wallet whitelisting criteria and vetting process; incident response protocol for compromised wallets; whether DTC can freeze or claw back tokens on-chain; reconciliation frequency between on-chain ledger and DTC books",
      "public_external_information_to_collect": "Network_framework security assessment criteria; public blockchain security incident databases; DTCC Important Notices for any wallet-related service alerts",
      "simulation_suitable": true,
      "simulation_limits": "No observed wallet compromise incidents in DTS; simulation requires assumed attack frequency and wallet count, both unobserved; results are entirely hypothetical",
      "public_driver_candidate": "Blockchain security audit reports for Canton and Besu; industry wallet compromise incident statistics (e.g., Chainalysis reports)",
      "validation_needed": "Confirm whether DTC has contractual or technical ability to freeze tokens on-chain; obtain wallet vetting SLA; confirm reconciliation architecture between on-chain state and DTC official records"
    },
    {
      "card_id": "DAS-04",
      "name_en": "Reconciliation Failure Between On-Chain Ledger and DTC Official Records",
      "name_zh": "链上账本与DTC官方记录对账失败风险",
      "external_shock": "Software bug, data feed interruption, or network fork creates divergence between tokenized position records on-chain and DTC's authoritative book-entry records",
      "transmission_pathway_en": "On-chain token state diverges from DTC book-entry records (e.g., due to chain reorganization, oracle failure, or processing error) → DTC cannot confirm authoritative ownership → corporate actions (dividends, votes, splits) applied to wrong beneficial owner → participants receive incorrect entitlements → regulatory reporting to SEC/FINRA based on DTC records conflicts with on-chain state → legal uncertainty over true ownership; potential double-counting of securities",
      "transmission_pathway_zh": "链上代币状态与DTC账簿记录产生分歧（如因链重组、预言机故障或处理错误）→DTC无法确认权威所有权→公司行动（股息、投票、拆股）适用于错误的实际受益人→参与者收到错误权益→基于DTC记录向SEC/FINRA的监管报告与链上状态冲突→真实所有权存在法律不确定性；潜在证券双重计算风险",
      "mechanism_source_ids": ["launch", "notice_das001", "network_framework"],
      "mechanism_evidence_quote": "Tokenized securities, or digital twins, retain the ownership rights, investor protections and economic entitlements of their traditional counterparts",
      "mechanism_evidence_source_id": "launch",
      "proposed_internal_buffer_metric": "Reconciliation cycle frequency and maximum tolerated divergence threshold between on-chain token ledger and DTC book-entry system",
      "metric_units": "Reconciliation cycles per day; maximum position discrepancy tolerance (number of positions or notional value)",
      "risk_direction": "Upward — any increase in tokenized positions or supported networks increases reconciliation complexity",
      "real_v_available": false,
      "exact_data_needed": "DTC reconciliation architecture and frequency; escalation protocol for detected discrepancies; which system (on-chain or DTC book-entry) is treated as authoritative in a conflict; corporate action processing workflow for tokenized securities",
      "public_external_information_to_collect": "DTCC Important Notices for any reconciliation-related service alerts; SEC reporting requirements for tokenized securities; DTCC rulebook amendments related to DTS",
      "simulation_suitable": false,
      "simulation_limits": "Reconciliation failure depends on internal system architecture details not publicly available; cannot be meaningfully simulated without DTC system design documentation",
      "public_driver_candidate": "DTCC regulatory rule filings; SEC no-action letter conditions on record-keeping",
      "validation_needed": "Obtain DTC's reconciliation SLA and discrepancy resolution protocol; confirm which ledger is legally authoritative; review corporate action processing rules for tokenized positions"
    },
    {
      "card_id": "DAS-05",
      "name_en": "Conversion Capacity Concentration / Participant Cliff Risk",
      "name_zh": "转换容量集中／参与者悬崖风险",
      "external_shock": "Market stress event (e.g., sharp equity sell-off or liquidity crisis) triggers simultaneous de-tokenization requests from multiple large participants",
      "transmission_pathway_en": "Stress event causes multiple large participants to simultaneously submit de-tokenization (conversion back to traditional form) orders →
